approved_scopes.detail: The S6 pentad certificate genuinely enumerates15 synthemes, all five-subsets with complete edge coverage, six pentads and all720 distinct action images; the transposition image has type2^3. The E8 projection counts all240 doubled-coordinate roots and the full fiber histogram24 long singleton images,24 short eight-element fibers and the24-element zero fiber. These are exhaustive finite certificates, not sampled claims.

The centered monodromy filtration and sl2 indexing are consistent; the integer coinvariants retain Z/n torsion. The lower-middle cone cutoff for a real3-dimensional cone on T2 correctly retains IH1 and kills the link2-cycle. The hypersurface cotangent complex and a-to-a-squared lifting obstruction are correct in the stated characteristic-zero model. The unipotent complement action correctly rules out a splitting canonical from the filtered-vector-space data alone, without denying additional mixed-Hodge splitting theorems.

The positive metric eta=(S inverse)*S inverse, exact weighted orthogonality and Jordan obstruction are correct. At s=1,t=pi the Euclidean norm1+sqrt2 is consistent with the matrix singular values. The F2-squared projective cocycle is nontrivial by its antisymmetric multiplier ratio. Controlled-unitary statements retain a separate error-model requirement.

Weighted cancellation and pairing use the same measure; the exact two-point atom saturates the stated BMO2 inequality. The result deliberately stops short of full global weighted H1-BMO duality. Hyperbolic3 volume growth, the radial ground-state transform and bottom spectral value1 are consistent with non-doubling global geometry. The hyperbolic cusp has finite area1/Y but infinite vertical extent, while the complete translation quotient has infinite area.

The Berry curvature and integrated flux agree within the expressly declared sign/Chern convention; the two-chart obstruction follows from Stokes and is kept separate from algebraic rigidity.

The repetition code corrects precisely its stated bit-flip family and has weight-one logical Z, hence quantum distance1. The depolarizing Kraus coefficients and exact trace-distance factor(1-p)^n are valid for0<=p<=1. Bell and incoherent-mixture parity observations collide while XX distinguishes them and trace distance is1/2. The associator pentagon is exact on pure tensors and the five-edge unitary-error telescoping bound is valid.
